exposure: Patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) with patient education program
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) without a special training program
cohort: 100 patients undergoing elective Cesarean section were randomly divided into two groups.
finding: Patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) provided earlier and more effective pain reduction after elective Cesarean section compared to non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), with its effect evident after 6 hours versus 12 hours for NSAIDs.
